title: Create src/lib/preflight.ts — pre-loop checks
description: Create a preflight module that runs all checks needed before starting the rocket loop. Validates tasks.json exists, has incomplete tasks, and the selected backend binary is in PATH.
acceptanceCriteria: Throws with 'run rocket init' message if tasks.json is missing
Throws with install instructions if the backend binary is not in PATH
Throws with 'All tasks complete' message if no incomplete tasks remain
Does not throw when all checks pass

steps.details: Create the file. Import fs-extra, readTasks, getIncompleteTasks from tasks/reader.ts. Import AgentBackend from backends/types.ts. Import checkBinaryInPath from this file (or separate helper).
export function checkBinaryInPath(binary: string): boolean { try { execSync(`which ${binary}`, { stdio: 'ignore' }); return true } catch { return false } }

export async function runPreflight(agentDir: string, backend: AgentBackend): Promise<void> { // 1. Check tasks.json exists const tasksFile = path.join(agentDir, 'tasks.json'); if (!await fs.pathExists(tasksFile)) { throw new Error('No tasks.json found. Run rocket init to set up the .agent/ directory.') } // 2. Read and validate tasks const tasks = await readTasks(agentDir); // 3. Check incomplete tasks if (getIncompleteTasks(tasks).length === 0) { throw new Error('All tasks are complete! Nothing to loop on.') } // 4. Check backend binary (done by the backend itself when spawning, but pre-check here for better UX) }

technicalNotes: checkBinaryInPath must also be exported — it's used by TASK-105 independently
The backend binary check is also done by the backend's spawn() method, but doing it in preflight gives a better error message before the loop starts
